# Inter 4.1

Self-hosted variable WOFF2 from the official Inter 4.1 release:
https://github.com/rsms/inter/releases/download/v4.1/Inter-4.1.zip

The font is distributed under the included SIL Open Font License.
`font-display: swap` retains readable system fallback while loading; `cv05`
distinguishes lowercase l from uppercase I. No external font request is needed.
